title: Entitlement Carried From a Relinquished Montgomery GI Bill Chapter
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 8 — Days carried into the Post-9/11 GI Bill from a relinquished chapter (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education)).**

**8.01 Ledger figure.** The days carried from the relinquished chapter (Chapter 30 or Chapter 1606) follow its entitlement ledger: the days granted plus every restoration minus every charge. Those carried days form the Post-9/11 entitlement credited on the election.

**8.02 Rule.**
(a) When entitlement has been charged and days remain, the days remaining are carried.
(b) When entitlement has been charged and no days remain (the ledger figure is nothing or less), 12 months of 30 days — 360 days — are carried.
(c) When no entitlement has ever been charged, the full grant is carried: 36 months of 30 days, 1080 days.

**8.03 Cases (hypothetical ledgers on a 1080-day grant).**

| Days charged | Days restored | Ledger figure | Days carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| 900 | 45 | 225 | 225 under (a) |
| 1079 | 0 | 1 | 1 under (a) |
| 1080 | 0 | 0 | 360 under (b) |
| 1100 | 0 | Less than nothing | 360 under (b) |
| None | None | 1080 | 1080 under (c) |

**8.04 Note.** A restoration entry on the relinquished chapter's ledger raises the ledger figure by the days it restores.
